latestVersion.changelog:
Ad Video skill initial release — fast, pro-grade ad video creation from your raw clips.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files (up to 500MB) for instant ad generation, no video editing skills needed.
- Simple commands like "cut this footage into a 15-second ad with text overlays" generate export-ready 1080p MP4 clips.
- Automated session and token management: works with NEMO_TOKEN or anonymous login and free trial credits.
- Cloud GPU rendering handles all export, effects, and compression with quick turnaround (1–2 minutes typical).
- Comprehensive error handling and feedback for uploads, exports, and credits.
- All API calls include proper authentication and support for batch workflows and iterative editing.
